title: Dancing Warrior Child
description: Three sequential views of a young Black child with wild dreadlocks performing energetic dance moves. The child wears an elaborate orange steampunk-inspired armored outfit with skull motifs, striped arm wraps, and heavy boots, captured mid-motion against a dark studio backdrop with dramatic lighting and visible water splashes.
prompt: A young Black child with flying dreadlocks captured in three dynamic dance poses wearing detailed orange steampunk armor with skull decorations, striped wraps, utility belts and heavy boots. The child is shown in left stance, jumping mid-air, and splashing pose with water flying from the boots. Dramatic studio lighting, dark moody background, cinematic realism, highly detailed textures.
